text:
[Act: income-tax-2025
 Chapter: Collection and Recovery of Tax
 Section: 404::Conditions of liability to pay advance tax.
]


Advance tax shall be payable by the assessee during a financial year, where the amount of such tax payable during that year, as computed under this Part, is Rs. 10000 or more.

metadata.section_title: Conditions of liability to pay advance tax.
